description.value: Beaver Convenience & Pizzeria is a community-oriented convenience store and in-house pizzeria in Courtenay, BC, proudly serving the neighbourhood for over a decade. Alongside everyday snacks and groceries, the store runs a full pizzeria offering build-your-own and specialty pies, fresh-tossed chili baked wings, and over 20 flavours of ice cream. Cyclists will find indoor and outdoor seating, an ATM, and a Bitcoin ATM on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM tags on name, address, and phone. The website describes the business as a convenience store offering snacks, groceries, ATM, Bitcoin ATM, indoor/outdoor seating, 20+ ice cream flavours, and homemade pizzas — confirming the Groceries category. Ice is confirmed via a featured product listing ('Ice Cube 2.3KG'); hot food is confirmed via the full pizzeria and wings menu. Bike parking, water refill, washrooms, and other cycling-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Beaver Convenience' but the business markets itself as 'Beaver Convenience & Pizzeria' on its website — the pizzeria component is significant and may warrant a name update in OSM.
Website footer shows '© 2035 by The Pizza Shop' — the future year is a Wix template artifact and the 'The Pizza Shop' attribution is a template placeholder, not indicative of a different business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible convenience store and pizzeria in Courtenay, BC with a confirmed website and operating details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking groceries, hot food, and ice.

Hot food.detail: Full pizzeria menu (build-your-own, specialty pizzas, take & bake) and fresh-tossed chili baked wings available in-store and for delivery

Ice.detail: Ice Cube 2.3KG listed as a featured product on the website
